content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am facing an issue when trying to load a program from a microSD card into a [product_name] [article_no] [version_no]. The display shows: Error empty... The program was saved onto the microSD using another [product_name] ([version_no]), where it works properly. Are [product_name] modules with [version_no] compatible with the same microSD and program?

The modules are not exactly the same, since the newer [version_no] uses upgraded hardware. You should open your old project (created in [product_name] [version_no]) using the newer [product_name] [version_no], select the correct hardware ([product_name] [article_no] [version_no]), and then save the updated program to the SD card.
Thanks, but [company_name] could have made users aware of this...

Why? [company_name] released the new [product_name] [article_no] [version_no] along with newer software ([product_name] [version_no]). This update is necessary because the hardware type ([product_name] [article_no] [version_no]) must be specified. The older software version does not allow you to select the newer hardware revision. Product innovations: [product_name] [version_no].

I understand, but typically earlier [product_name] versions with the same product code (e.g. [article_no]) are cross-compatible. Many people will likely be surprised by these restrictions. I contacted a representative from [company_name] Automation, who was not aware of this issue.
If you create a program for a [article_no] Standard module and select that hardware type, you will not be able to load the program into a [article_no] ES10 variant.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered unexpected incompatibility when transferring a program via microSD card between different hardware revisions of [product_name] modules, even though it worked on older models. The issue is connected to the need for updated project files, generated with newer, compatible software that supports the latest hardware. Users had assumed backward compatibility across module revisions based on previous experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect compatibility between different versions of [product_name] modules that share the same product code, especially when transferring programs via microSD card. There is also a clear expectation for improved communication from [company_name] regarding hardware and software compatibility requirements.
